title: Hold the General Lane
hook: The diamond is empty. The box in your lane is slow.
scene: Fog at dusk on 167. A box is doing thirty in the general lane. To the left, a diamond on the pavement and a solid white fence, empty and fast. The schedule wants the opening. You are a bus. You could live in that lane. What you cannot do is dart in, pass, and dart out. That is a passing lane you invented.
decision: The diamond is empty and he is slow. Do you use it to pass?

options.text: Dart into the diamond, pass, come back before the next ramp
options.result: You use a carpool lane as a slingshot. Solid white, in and out. The remnant in the cap does not care that you are a bus. You stole a pass from a lane that was never yours to dart through.

options.text: Hold the general lane. If you pass, pass in a general lane.
options.result: You stay. The diamond stays empty. When a general lane opens you take a real pass or you don't. The box stays at thirty. You stay legal.

options.text: Straddle the solid white until he notices and moves over
options.result: You occupy the fence. He never moves. Both lanes lose you. The diamond was never a shoulder and the solid was never an invitation.

options.text: Take the rumble on the right and go around him there
options.result: The rumble is a drain in the fog. You put a bus in the junk to avoid a rule. He never knew you tried.

debrief: A bus may travel in a carpool lane. Darting in to pass one vehicle and coming back is a steal. You missed a ticket by staying in the general lane.

source.psdp_skill: Skill nine: multi-lane roads – part one
source.teaching_target: HOV / carpool lanes are not passing lanes; do not enter one only to pass and return.

image_brief.subject: painted diamond and solid white fence on wet pavement to the left; a loaded dump truck filling the general lane ahead, brake lamps on, no gap past it, no readable occupancy numbers
image_brief.foreground: a strip of Ledger van hood at the bottom, still in the general lane, fog beading on the paint
image_brief.midground: the dump's high tailgate as a wall in your lane; the empty diamond fenced by solid white beside it — factory mirrors only on the dump, no cutaway body, no amber destination sign, no roof rack, no oversize door-mirror arms
image_brief.background: 167 dusk, fog eating the road ahead of the dump, general-lane stack tight behind you
image_brief.read: the diamond is empty and the dump is a wall — a pass you would have to steal

geometry.ego_lane_side: right-hand general lane beside an HOV lane
geometry.ego_nose_in_frame: a strip of van nose at the bottom, pointing up-frame
